summary: Frontend-only regression + Pack C (Smarter Learning + Admin Dashboard) testing. Ran full happy path Landing -> Onboarding -> Character -> Starter -> Hub -> Battle -> Egg -> Collection -> Academy -> Parent via Playwright with zero console errors. Verified procedural question engine (3+ unique prompts in 4 plays), reading-only mode, mixed mode, Admin PIN gate (wrong PIN error + 2580 unlock), template library (16 toggles + previews), companion grant/revoke/active, egg slider + force-hatch, sound toggle on TopBar, Parent->Admin link, admin-reset-all clears player, 8 academy cards including reading-vocab + rhyming, and localStorage persistence. Wrong answers correctly enter the tricky pool (battle feedback says "We'll bring this one back later.").

integration_issues.issue: Could not visually confirm the 🔁 'Tricky review' chip resurfacing within 10 follow-up questions during the automated run. The wrong-answer feedback ("We'll bring this one back later") fired and gameStore.recordWrong logic is correct, but the 55% probabilistic resurfacing + the fact that battles only have 6 questions (Battle.tsx defaults) means a fresh battle starts before the resurface index is reached. Recommend either (a) raising resurface probability when only 1 tricky entry exists, or (b) prioritising tricky pool the moment resurfaceAtIndex<=idx within the same battle session. Engine logic itself appears correct; this is a UX/observability concern.

action_items: Optional: surface tricky-pool entries more aggressively (e.g., 100% probability when only 1 entry due) so battle-tricky-chip is observable in QA without 10+ questions.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard NumberStat exposes the container via data-testid (admin-stat-level/xp/coins) but the +/- buttons inside have NO individual testids. Spec wording is satisfied (container testids exist and the buttons mutate values), but adding admin-stat-level-inc/dec etc. would make automated testing more deterministic.
gameStore.nextQuestion: tricky-resurface probability is hardcoded to 0.55 — consider exposing as a setting or scaling with tricky-pool size.
AdminDashboard.tsx is 456 lines; close to the 700-line threshold but still acceptable. Future sections (e.g., template editor) should be extracted into sub-files.

questionEngine ALGEBRA_LINEAR uses Math.random for operator+sign but the resulting equation x - a = right can produce right < 0; numericDistractors guards against negative distractors, which can occasionally collapse to <4 unique choices before fallback. Fallback works but the fallback values (multiples of 7) look out-of-place. Minor.
